logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the WO-03 compute node selection brief. One analytical figure, three linked panels on a light background: (1) eligibility gate table listing all four candidates with quality index against the 80 floor and raw defect count against the ceiling of 5, every row marked pass, with P3 highlighted and annotated as one defect below the ceiling; (2) measured-energy bar chart in Wh per fixed acceptance batch, ordered P3 10, P2 22, P1 28, P4 49, with a dashed reference line at the 10 Wh minimum and gap callouts +12, +18 and +39 Wh; (3) decision-flow strip from the trusted source table through the passing gates to the selected P3, ending in a note that cost, delivery, maintenance and field reliability are unverified and excluded. Flat vector style, navy accent, one green highlight on the selected bar, no decorative content.
